description: Expected outcome of scripts/prototype/check-receipt-assets.ts for every receipt fixture in this directory, against asset-map.json on chain 8453. scripts/prototype/check-receipt-assets.test.ts reads this file.

valid.note: Built from tests/fixtures/consensus-receipt.valid.json. The agent bucket is 0 because the fund has no agent asset. So the two analyst submissions carry new vectors and are re-signed. The signing keys are TEST KEYS: each Ed25519 seed is sha256("robotmoney one-vault experiment test key <member_id>"). Never use them for anything else. The submission mean is 0, 0.60, 0.25, 0.15, so weights are 0, 6000, 2500, 1500 under the largest-remainder rule. The assets are the §4.1 example.

refuse.fault: 100 bps moved from morpho-usdc (conservative_defi_yield) to weth (protocol_tokens). Assets still sum to 10000. The labelled sums are 5900 and 2600 against bucket weights 6000 and 2500.
morpho-usdc is 2400, so the assets sum to 9900.
despxa is renamed paxg. The asset map has no paxg row for chain 8453.
The cbbtc entry is replaced by a second weth entry.
despxa is labelled hard_assets, which is not a receipt bucket.
weights are the 1.0 valid fixture's (agent_tokens 1250). No asset is labelled agent_tokens.
despxa is dropped and its 1500 bps moved to cbbtc relabelled real_world_assets. Every active asset must be listed, so an omission never sells an asset.
aave-v3-usdc is 6100, above its 6000 capBps. Bucket and asset sums still hold.
weights is removed. assets depends on weights, because the bucket audit reads both.
schema_version is 1.0. Schema 1.0 has no assets field.
assets is removed. A 1.1 receipt without assets is schema-valid but gives a govern row nothing to submit.

compound-v3-usdc is labelled real_world_assets and despxa is labelled conservative_defi_yield. Both carry 1500 bps, so the labelled sums still match the bucket weights. The asset map fixes each asset's bucket, so the relabel is refused.
The assets list is reversed. Entry order is part of the canonical bytes, so entries must follow the asset map's canonical_asset_order.
assets comes before weights. Top-level keys must follow schema order, so assets is the last field.
